Preset Pack 3 - A01 - StarWars Podracer          
                                        August 16,17,18th 2005 + a lot of days later
                                      + -------------------------+
                                      |   ABANDONED  |
                                      +--------------------------+
The idea for creating this preset came at the same time as the idea for R2-D2 (March 2004)

But just as with the StarWars movies, my techniqes weren't as far as to be able to create this on a computer.

I had to update my 3D SSC template for differently moving objects and to combine those.
The combining still needs some major work.

* Enable the second DM for the (b0rked and unfinished) 3D view

* Click+drag in the AVS window to manually rotate the camera (testing).

Podracer, StarWars by George Lucas.

Enjoy,

Warrior of the Light

contact:
 www.Warrior-of-the-Light.net.tc
  info.wotl@gmail.com


___Legal stuff___________________________________________
Feel free to use whatever you want of this preset, in any way you want. Just give clear credit of my name in the comment and title.


___Technical stuff._______________________________________

Time for creating and uptomizing this preset: Don't even ask.

regs used + where defined:
gvm 01..16+20
power coupling ssc :21..24
rod caclulations el: 28..33


Stuff I hate in this preset:
**the rods** (cables from the pod to the turbines)
I hate this 2D 3-point ssc.
There should somehow be a way to draw the original rods (in the disabled effect list) without going to the matrices twice or even three times per rod.

**3D DM's** (in general too =P)
Synchronizing ssc's and DM's in 3D is just a bitch.
It should be easier if I rotated the render 90 degrees up ( z --> (-y) ) and then rotate it all again so that the DM isn't in front of the render but below it. But that's quite a lot of work concidering all the modified rotations and stuff.

code.perPoint: y=y-t

code.perFrame:
//original rods
//remove 3-point ssc when using this
//rods positioning calculations
me=band(band(band(above(getkbmouse(1),-1),below(getkbmouse(1),1)),band(above(getkbmouse(2),-1),below(getkbmouse(2),1))),getkbmouse(3));
